title: Mondag
about: A piece for the caves. It is written for its biome as it stands, so every fader is 0 dB underground. The game keeps playing it when the player comes up into the open air, and it is meant to stand that; the 'open' hint only takes the celesta's drips out of the birdsong's way. The roles say what each lane does.

roles.lead: the tune: the vibraphone, and the voice when it sings the tune (bars 25–28): keep it
roles.foundation: the harp's seven-quaver figure and the bowed bass, the pulse and the floor: keep it
roles.bed: the voice holding the chords: already thin (nothing under 250 Hz)
roles.sparkle: the celesta's drips: high, struck, sparse; they share the top with the birdsong outdoors

lanes.label: Voice 1
lanes.note: sings the tune in bars 25–28 (lead there)
